<p class="page-lead"><strong>Pair</strong> applied project: a real business decision, appropriate methods in R, clear recommendation, and a live presentation with Q&amp;A.</p>

<p>Your brief, codebook and data file are on Canvas. All details about your case are there. Submit everything on Canvas.</p>

## Milestones

| Milestone | Date | Notes | Status |
|-----------|------|-------|--------|
| Project brief, codebook and data | **On Canvas** | One brief per pair, with its codebook and data | Posted on Canvas |
| **Graded checkpoint** | **Fri 20 Nov, 11:59 pm** | Knitted R notebook and a write-up of at most 2 pages | Details in the brief |
| Checkpoint meeting | **Tue 24 Nov, 4–6 pm** | 30 minutes per pair, in my office (2160) | Details in the brief |
| Final notebook and slides | **Tue 1 Dec, 11:59 pm** | Knitted R notebook and slides, on Canvas | Details in the brief |
| Presentations | **Wed 2 Dec** | Pair talk + individual Q&A | All three pairs, one session |

The brief gives the split of the project grade. The course grade for the project is **20%**.

## Attendance (presentation day)

Attendance is expected on Wed 2 Dec. If you miss the presentation session, you get a zero on the presentation and Q&A component, which is 40% of the project grade. Plan to stay for the whole session, not only your own slot.

The brief on Canvas says what data you use, what you hand in at the checkpoint and the final, and how the talk is graded. For dates, see the [schedule](../schedule.qmd).
